live-mode.title: Your panel drives the scene
live-mode.caption: In Live Mode every toggle, field and slider changes the scene right away: modifiers, light shadows, light power and the current frame.

add-panel.title: Add any widget in seconds
add-panel.caption: Press Shift A, type a few letters, pick the card and click to place the new widget on your canvas.

sculpt-wheel.title: A Ring Menu for sculpting
sculpt-wheel.caption: Hover the ring to see each brush, click one to use it, sculpt, flip pages and switch symmetry from the inner ring.

studio-modes.title: One canvas, a layer per mode
studio-modes.caption: Switch to Sculpt, Texture Paint, Weight Paint or Draw and the canvas shows the controls made for that mode.

edit-layout.title: Lay out with snapping and the Selection Bar
edit-layout.caption: Drag widgets with smart snapping guides, align and distribute them from the Selection Bar, then group them and move them as one.

from-property.title: Bind any property with a right-click
from-property.caption: Choose From Property, right-click a property in Blender and get a widget already bound to it, ready to drive the scene.

lineal-slider.title: Precise sliders
lineal-slider.caption: Drag a Lineal slider, hold Shift for ten times finer control, or double-click it and type an exact value.

themes.title: Themes
themes.caption: One canvas through the Default theme, two user themes and the Light appearance.

picker-select-transform.title: Click in the picker, pose in the viewport
picker-select-transform.caption: With the rig's controls hidden, click a body part in the picker, then move or rotate it with G or R in the viewport: the arm, the head and the spine.

picker-face-gaze.title: Aim the eyes, then shape the face
picker-face-gaze.caption: Drag the gaze pad and the character's eyeballs follow; then pick the brows and the mouth corners on the face chart and move them for a smile, no controls cluttering the face.

picker-hands-curl.title: Curl a hand in one move
picker-hands-curl.caption: Shift-click the four finger masters in the picker and curl them together in the viewport (R, X X), then the thumb.

picker-pages.title: Body, hands, feet and face on tabs
picker-pages.caption: Each part of the character has its own tab, drawn over the character art: switch tabs and pick fingers, feet or the jaw.

picker-ikfk.title: Switch IK and FK with one click
picker-ikfk.caption: The puck beside the hand flips the arm between IK and FK, and the Rig Settings slider blends between them.

picker-gaze.title: Aim the eyes with a gaze pad
picker-gaze.caption: Drag the Eyes pad and the character's eyeballs follow, the eyes drawn on the pad looking along; the pad's range keeps the irises in sight.

picker-pose.title: Pose a character from the picker
picker-pose.caption: Click a control on the body chart to select it, then move or rotate it in the viewport: the hands, the chest and the head pose the character.

picker-face.title: Pick face controls on a face chart
picker-face.caption: Pick brows and mouth corners on the drawn face, Shift for both sides, and move them in the viewport for an expression.

picker-mirror.title: Mirrored layout editing
picker-mirror.caption: In Edit Mode, move a left control and its right twin moves with it, mirrored across the body.

control-panel-dark.title: Studio control panel (Dark)
control-panel-dark.caption: A control panel canvas next to the 3D Viewport: lights, render settings, playback and objects one click away.

control-panel-light.title: Studio control panel (Light)
control-panel-light.caption: The same control panel in the Light appearance, next to a light Blender theme.

control-panel-dark-area.title: Control panel canvas (Dark)
control-panel-dark-area.caption: A finished canvas in Live Mode: switches, sliders, number fields, swatches and buttons grouped in frames.

control-panel-light-area.title: Control panel canvas (Light)
control-panel-light-area.caption: The control panel canvas in the Light appearance.

studio-sculpt.title: FlexSpace Studio: Sculpt layer
studio-sculpt.caption: Enter Sculpt Mode and the canvas jumps to its Sculpt layer: brushes, stroke, remesh, masks and face sets.

studio-texture-paint.title: FlexSpace Studio: Texture Paint layer
studio-texture-paint.caption: In Texture Paint the canvas shows a colour picker, swatches, paint brushes, masks and projection settings.

studio-object.title: FlexSpace Studio: Object layer
studio-object.caption: Select the Geometry Nodes tower and the canvas shows its layer: shape, details, materials and colour controls.

studio-look-dev.title: FlexSpace Studio: Look Dev layer
studio-look-dev.caption: Click the shader ball and its Look Dev layer goes live: colour pickers for the material, the world and the key light.

studio-weight-paint.title: FlexSpace Studio: Weight Paint layer
studio-weight-paint.caption: In Weight Paint the canvas shows weight brushes, quick weight values, options, symmetry and vertex groups.

studio-draw.title: FlexSpace Studio: Draw layer
studio-draw.caption: In Grease Pencil Draw Mode the canvas shows pencils and inks, colour, layers, stroke, animation and canvas tools.

layer-tabs.title: Layers and modes
layer-tabs.caption: One canvas, a layer per mode: the tabs show each layer's mode, the active one is outlined.

layers-panel.title: Layers panel
layers-panel.caption: The Layers panel: a layer per mode, Show When and Switch Layers Automatically.

ring-menu-inner.title: Ring Menu toggles
ring-menu-inner.caption: The inner ring holds toggles and operators: symmetry, automasking, Dyntopo, masks.

ring-menu-page.title: Ring Menu pages
ring-menu-page.caption: More brushes than fit? Pages: the tab under the ring flips them.

ring-menu-canvas.title: Sculpt Wheel demo
ring-menu-canvas.caption: The Sculpt Wheel demo: a Ring Menu, a round Favorites frame, quick brushes, radius and strength.

add-browser.title: Add Widget browser
add-browser.caption: Shift A opens the Add Widget browser over the canvas: search, categories and a card per widget.

add-browser-search.title: Search as you type
add-browser-search.caption: Type a few letters and the best matches show across every category; Enter adds the selected one.

add-browser-data.title: Categories and subcategories
add-browser-data.caption: The Data category opens into Toggles, Choices, Numbers, Color, Text and Lists, each under its own heading.

add-menu.title: Header Add menu
add-menu.caption: The header's Add menu: Search, From Property and every category, its subcategories under headings.

snapping-guides.title: Smart snapping
snapping-guides.caption: Drag a frame and it snaps to the edges, centres and equal gaps of its neighbours, with guides that show why.

selection-bar.title: Selection Bar
selection-bar.caption: With several widgets selected, the Selection Bar aligns, distributes and matches their sizes.

selection-handles.title: Selection handles
selection-handles.caption: Handles resize the selection, the round knob rotates it and the chip shows its size.

minimap.title: Minimap
minimap.caption: The minimap shows the whole canvas while you work zoomed in: click to jump, drag to pan.

layout-widgets.title: Frames, groups and flex boxes
layout-widgets.caption: Frames hold widgets and move them as one; Flex Boxes and Groups keep them in line.

flex-box.title: Flex Box
flex-box.caption: Flex Boxes line widgets up in a row or a column: here Suzanne's location, rotation and scale, each added in one pick with From Property.

frames.title: Frames
frames.caption: Frames give a panel its sections: a title, a background, and they carry their widgets when moved.

group.title: Group
group.caption: A Group moves, rotates and resizes several widgets as one; double-click to go inside.

from-property-shot.title: Add from Property
from-property-shot.caption: The light's colour, right-clicked in the Properties editor, is now a Color Swatch on the canvas.

binding-eyedropper.title: Binding eyedropper
binding-eyedropper.caption: Bind a slider with the eyedropper: right-click any slider-like property, here the light's Exposure.

binding-data-path.title: Bound data path
binding-data-path.caption: After the pick the slider is bound to the light's exposure, pinned to that light, and labelled for you.

broken-bindings.title: Broken bindings
broken-bindings.caption: A mistyped path or the wrong kind of property gets a dashed outline, and the top bar counts them.

top-bar-status.title: Canvas top bar
top-bar-status.caption: The top bar in Edit Mode: the preset and its state (Modified, Overwrite, Sync, Unlink), and the bindings that need you.

theme-sunset.title: Sunset theme
theme-sunset.caption: The same canvas in a user theme, Sunset: made in the theme editor in a few clicks.

theme-violet.title: Violet theme
theme-violet.caption: The same canvas in a user theme, Violet: made in the theme editor in a few clicks.

theme-light.title: Light appearance
theme-light.caption: Every theme has a Dark and a Light mode; Auto follows Blender's own theme.

theme-menu.title: Themes and Appearance
theme-menu.caption: Pick a theme and its appearance, Auto, Dark or Light, or open the theme editor, from the View menu.

presets-menu.title: Global presets
presets-menu.caption: Save any canvas as a global preset and add it to any project from a menu of thumbnails.

top-bar-preset.title: Global presets
top-bar-preset.caption: A canvas linked to a global preset: the top bar shows its name and that it is up to date.

library.title: Library
library.caption: The Canvas tab of the sidebar: the layers and the Library of global presets and local canvases.

empty-state.title: Get started
empty-state.caption: No canvas yet? One click makes one, or open a finished demo to see how it is built.

picker-layer-female-body.title: Body page (female)
picker-layer-female-body.caption: The whole Body page: torso, limbs, IK and FK controls, poles and tweaks over the female art, with the Rig Settings knobs and sliders and the bone collection switches.

picker-layer-female-face.title: Face page (female)
picker-layer-female-face.caption: The whole Face page: every face control on the female face, the Expressions frame with the gaze pad drawn as eyes (here looking aside), the mouth pads and knobs, the teeth and tongue and the face bone collections.

picker-layer-female-hands.title: Hands page (female)
picker-layer-female-hands.caption: Both hands, every finger segment, the finger masters under each hand and the IK / FK controls at the wrists, with the finger collection switches.

picker-layer-female-feet.title: Feet page (female)
picker-layer-female-feet.caption: Both feet: the IK, heel and toe controls, the FK bars and every toe with its master, and a switch for the toe collection.

picker-layer-male-body.title: Body page (male)
picker-layer-male-body.caption: The whole Body page: torso, limbs, IK and FK controls, poles and tweaks over the male art, with the Rig Settings knobs and sliders and the bone collection switches.

picker-layer-male-face.title: Face page (male)
picker-layer-male-face.caption: The whole Face page: every face control on the male face, the Expressions frame with the gaze pad drawn as eyes (here looking aside), the mouth pads and knobs, the teeth and tongue and the face bone collections.

picker-layer-male-hands.title: Hands page (male)
picker-layer-male-hands.caption: Both hands, every finger segment, the finger masters under each hand and the IK / FK controls at the wrists, with the finger collection switches.

picker-layer-male-feet.title: Feet page (male)
picker-layer-male-feet.caption: Both feet: the IK, heel and toe controls, the FK bars and every toe with its master, and a switch for the toe collection.

picker-hero.title: Pose a character from its picker
picker-hero.caption: A rigged character posed from the Body page: click a body part to select its control, then move it in the 3D Viewport.

picker-face-closeup.title: Face close-up
picker-face-closeup.caption: The posed face up close, a smile, raised brows and the eyes looking aside, with the Face page next to it; Solo on Face (Primary) shows only the main face controls.

picker-pose-body.title: Body page
picker-pose-body.caption: The Body page over the character art: FK regions, IK hands and feet, poles, spine and tweaks, with rig settings and bone collection switches.

picker-pose-hands.title: Hands page
picker-pose-hands.caption: Every finger segment of both hands over the hand art, with the finger masters under each hand and the IK, FK and switch controls at the wrist.

picker-pose-feet.title: Feet page
picker-pose-feet.caption: Heel, foot, spin and toe controls of both feet over the foot art, with the IK / FK switch and the leg collection switches.

picker-pose-face.title: Face page
picker-pose-face.caption: Brows, lids, cheeks, nose, lips and jaw drawn on a face, with teeth and tongue, an eyes gaze control and mouth pads for expressions.

picker-male-body.title: Body chart picker (male)
picker-male-body.caption: The Humanoid Body chart for a male Rigify rig: one click adds the whole page, drawn over the body art.

picker-female-body.title: Body chart picker (female)
picker-female-body.caption: The same chart for a female Rigify rig, drawn over the female body art.

picker-hands.title: Hands picker
picker-hands.caption: The Humanoid Body's Hands page: every finger bone of both hands, mirrored left and right, with the finger collections on top.

picker-feet.title: Feet picker
picker-feet.caption: The Humanoid Body's Feet page: heel, foot and toe controls and every toe segment, with a switch for the toe collection.

picker-humanoid-face.title: Face page picker
picker-humanoid-face.caption: The Face page of the Humanoid Body chart: every face control on the anime face, a gaze pad drawn as eyes, mouth pads, knobs, the teeth and tongue and the face bone collections.

picker-edit-snapping.title: Edit the picker layout
picker-edit-snapping.caption: Drag a frame in Edit Mode: snapping guides, equal-spacing marks, the position chip and a ghost of where it started.

picker-edit-selected.title: Picker in Edit Mode
picker-edit-selected.caption: A knob selected in Edit Mode: resize handles, the size chip and the minimap of the page.

w-operator.title: Widget: Operator button
w-operator.caption: A button that runs any Blender operator, here Render Image.

w-custom-script.title: Widget: Script button
w-custom-script.caption: A button that runs your own Python script.

w-toggle.title: Widget: Toggle
w-toggle.caption: A switch bound to a true/false property, here a light's shadow.

w-enum.title: Widget: Enum
w-enum.caption: A segmented choice bound to an enum property, here the render engine.

w-color-swatch.title: Widget: Color Swatch
w-color-swatch.caption: A colour swatch bound to a colour property, here the light colour.

w-color-picker.title: Widget: Color Picker
w-color-picker.caption: A full colour picker on the canvas with a wheel, value bar and HSV rows.

w-color-palette.title: Widget: Color Palette
w-color-palette.caption: A palette of swatches: click one to set the bound colour.

w-brush-picker.title: Widget: Brush Picker
w-brush-picker.caption: A button that makes one brush active, with its preview.

w-ring-menu.title: Widget: Ring Menu
w-ring-menu.caption: Brushes on an outer ring, toggles and operators on an inner ring, in pages.

w-list.title: Widget: List
w-list.caption: A list of items with add and remove buttons, here the material slots.

w-lineal-slider.title: Widget: Slider
w-lineal-slider.caption: A linear slider bound to a number, here the light power.

w-number-field.title: Widget: Number Field
w-number-field.caption: A Blender-style number field you drag, click or type into.

w-label.title: Widget: Label
w-label.caption: A text label that can show a live value, here the current frame.

w-image.title: Widget: Image
w-image.caption: An image on the canvas, here a packed render of the scene.

w-frame.title: Widget: Frame
w-frame.caption: A titled frame that holds and moves a group of widgets.

w-flex-box.title: Widget: Flex Box
w-flex-box.caption: A box that lays its widgets out for you, made in one go from a vector property.

w-group.title: Widget: Group
w-group.caption: Widgets grouped to move and resize together, shown selected in Edit Mode.

w-bone-collection-toggle.title: Widget: Bone Collection toggle
w-bone-collection-toggle.caption: Show or hide a bone collection, with a Solo radio next to it.

w-radial-slider.title: Widget: Knob
w-radial-slider.caption: A radial slider for a rig property, here Rigify's Head Follow.

w-lineal-2d-slider.title: Widget: 2D Pad
w-lineal-2d-slider.caption: Two properties on one pad, X and Y: a gaze, a mouth corner, any pair of values.

w-bone-pickers.title: Widgets: bone pickers
w-bone-pickers.caption: A button, an image button and a shape, each selecting its bone on click.
